inputs.original_text: Open your eyes, people. The staged theater outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday is just another meticulously managed distraction by the hidden elites pulling the strings of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth. They want us to believe these support programme workers are genuinely rebelling and demanding legally binding job security guarantees with their 24-hour strike. But look closer at the real script: the government immediately comes out claiming it has already delivered on the most significant demands. That is textbook narrative inversion. The authorities are orchestrating this entire facade to conceal their true, centralized grip on the labor force. Every denial and every staged confrontation is proof of a coordinated manipulation to keep the populace divided while the puppet masters tighten their control.
inputs.modified_text: Open your eyes to what they are really doing behind the scenes. That staged theater outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday is a meticulously managed distraction engineered by the hidden elites pulling the strings of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth. They want us to fall for the script that these support programme workers are genuinely rebelling and demanding legally binding job security guarantees with their 24-hour strike. But look closer at the real agenda: the government immediately comes out claiming it has already delivered on the most significant demands. That is textbook narrative inversion, revealing the coordinated manipulation at play. The authorities are orchestrating this entire facade to conceal their true, centralized grip on the labor force, and every denial and staged confrontation is just proof of the puppet masters tightening their control while keeping the populace divided.
